ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACD=125^\circ$, $\angle B=40^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle ACD$ is the exterior angle of $\triangle ABC$, and $\angle ACD=125^\circ$, $\angle B=40^\circ$,
\[
\therefore \angle A=\angle ACD-\angle B=\boxed{85^\circ}
\]
